idea-plugin.name: past.dev
idea-plugin.description:
Your conversations with Junie become memory, and Junie can recall it.

past.dev is a memory platform. This plugin connects Junie, in the IDE's AI chat and in its terminal, to a past.dev project: each session is read into past.dev when it is over, and past.dev's past_recall tool on the IDE's MCP server gives Junie what was decided before, why, and what was already tried.

Only the prose of a conversation travels: what you typed and what Junie answered. Tool runs, file contents and diffs stay on this machine. Nothing is sent before you allow it. Requires a project API key from the past.dev console.
idea-plugin.change-notes:
0.2.0

  • past_recall answers with a fuller page: up to a hundred memories within two thousand tokens, most relevant first, each with the time it was said, a mark where something later replaced it, and the passages of the conversations it came from. It answered with eight one-line memories before.
  • What you type is sent with the key it was typed under, and with no other. Nothing typed while the machine had no key is sent, and what was typed under one project's key never goes to another project.
  • A session sent carries the name of the project's folder, never its path.
  • Each session sent names the model Junie was set to and its effort level.

0.1.0, the first release.

  • Junie's sessions, in the IDE's AI chat and in the Junie CLI, are sent to past.dev in sittings once they have been quiet for 30 minutes, and when the IDE quits. Nothing is sent before you allow it.
  • past_recall on the IDE's MCP server, listed to Junie as a tool of its own.
  • The past.dev tool window: status, Send now, Send history… and search.
